decisive_items: Spherical broadly based budding yeast on Grocott-Gomori methenamine silver stain
response.rationale: Blastomycosis is more likely due to the presence of Blastomyces urine antigen and characteristic yeast morphology on Grocott-Gomori methenamine silver stain

rejected.why: Histoplasmosis blood antigen is present, but the clinical and laboratory findings are more consistent with Blastomycosis
